newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia tenders for 16,300 tonnes sugar beet seeds.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia tenders for 16,300 tonnes sugar beet seeds.

text.p: Tunisia has launched an international tender for the purchase of 16,300 tonnes of sugar beet seeds for 1997/98 agricultural season, an official said on Thursday.

"We launched a tender for the purchase of a total 16,300 tonnes sugar beet seeds on the international market for 1997/98 season. This kind of tender is launched once a year to respond to our agriculture needs," an official at the Complexe Sucrier de Tunisie told Reuters.
He said the closing date was set for March 24, 1997.
Tunisia's sugar beet harvest was 300,000 tonnes in 1996, up by 19 percent over the previous year, officials said.
The country imported 187,400 tonnes of sugar worth 68.7 million dinars in 1995. Updated figures were not immediately available.
